tests_performed.service_card_navigation: Not fully verified in automation because the homepage opens a 'Allow location access' modal overlay on first visit, which intercepts clicks before a service card is reachable in default viewport. Not a regression caused by this fix; pre-existing UX. Main agent can self-test by dismissing the modal.

critical_code_review_comments: setupProxy.js correctly gates the SSR body injection behind an isBot regex and only injects crawlable fallback for bots; browsers get the SPA shell with the loader. Clean implementation.

index.html loader uses position:fixed + z-index:9999 inside #root; React's createRoot(...).render replaces #root children on mount which cleanly removes the loader. Verified no leftover .azo-boot after mount.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified end-to-end. Browser UA => SPA shell + spinner then React mounts; Googlebot UA => SSR fallback body remains for SEO. On homepage a 'Allow location access' modal appears on first load which may block service-card clicks in automated flows unless dismissed.
